| 403    | Your key may not assert this `authority.principalId`                                                   | `Caller is not permitted to assert this authority.principalId.`    |
| 404    | The policy named in the request does not exist                                                         | `Policy 'does-not-exist' version '9.9.9' was not found.`           |
| 409    | The `businessTransactionId` was already used, see [Idempotency](/api-reference/idempotency-and-nonces) | `Business Transaction '<id>' already exists.`                      |
| 413    | The body is too large                                                                                  | `Payload too large.`                                               |
| 500    | Anything unexpected                                                                                    | `Internal Server Error`                                            |

**`POST /policies/validate` does not use this envelope.** Every status it returns (200, 400, 404) is
`{"valid": boolean, "errors": string[]}`, for example `{"valid": false, "errors": ["policyId is required."]}`. The
one exception is `401`: caller authentication runs before the route, so a rejected caller sees
`{"error": "authentication required"}`.

## An incomplete body is a 400

A `POST /execute` or `POST /transactions` body without `metadata`, `authority`, `authorization`, `intent` or
`policy`, or with one of them `null` or not an object, or with a required field that is not a string, is refused with
`400` naming it, for example:

```json
{ "error": "policy is required and must be an object." }
```

Nothing is executed. Until 2026-10-06 a missing `policy` or `authorization` reached the validator and was answered
with a bare `500` (G-87 in `docs/VERIFICATION-GAPS.md`). A fuzz test now sends damaged and arbitrary bodies to both
routes and requires that neither ever answers `500`.

Fixed earlier too: "no connector registered for this capability" used to be a bare `500` too. It is now
`503 CONNECTOR_NOT_REGISTERED`.

## The SDKs

Both SDKs raise one exception class per status. In the TypeScript SDK, `AuthorizationError` and `InternalServerError`
keep the server's `code` on `serverCode`. See [TypeScript SDK](/sdks/typescript) and [Python SDK](/sdks/python) for
each class.

---

## Idempotency and Nonces

Source: https://docs.parmanasystems.com/api-reference/idempotency-and-nonces

<Info>
  **[AVAILABLE]**. No `Idempotency-Key` header exists anywhere in this API. This
  page describes the real mechanism, not a gap.
</Info>

## businessTransactionId is the idempotency key, but not Stripe's kind

`POST /execute` and `POST /transactions` require a caller supplied `businessTransactionId` (a UUID). Sending the same
one twice does **not** replay the first response the way Stripe's `Idempotency-Key` does. The second request fails
with `409` and no `code`:

```json
{
  "error": "Business Transaction 'a1a1a1a1-1111-4111-8111-111111111111' already exists."
}
```

The 409 is the same whether the first request was approved, refused or is still running, so it tells you only that
the id was used. To find out what happened to it, read it back with the same id:

| The first request was                    | Read                                         | Answer                                                                                                        |
| ---------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Approved and executed                    | `GET /trust-records/{businessTransactionId}` | `200` with the Execution Trust Record                                                                         |
| Refused (`403 POLICY_DENIED` and others) | `GET /refusal/{businessTransactionId}`       | `200` with the signed Refusal Record. `GET /trust-records/{id}` answers `404`: a refusal has no Trust Record. |
| Either                                   | `GET /transactions/{businessTransactionId}`  | `200` with the Business Transaction as it was stored                                                          |

**Practical guidance for callers:** derive `businessTransactionId` from your own idempotency key (a UUIDv5 of your
order id, for example) so a retry uses the same id. Treat a `409` on that id as "already submitted, go and read it",
not as a failure.

<Warning>
  **After a timeout, read before you send again.** An approved request can take
  tens of seconds (see `docs/VERIFICATION-GAPS.md` G-84), longer than a client's
  default timeout. The request keeps running on the server, and the action may
  be performed. If your client times out, read `GET /trust-records/
  {businessTransactionId}` (and `GET /refusal/{id}`) with the same id first.
  Sending the action again under a **new** id would ask for it a second time.
  Set your client timeout to 120 seconds.
</Warning>

## Nonces: each authorization and each approval is accepted once

A caller never sends or manages a nonce. The word means two single use values inside the server's own pipeline:

- **The authorization nonce.** Every approved decision becomes a `SignedExecutionAuthorization` with its own `nonce`.
  The [gateway](/concepts/the-gateway) consumes it before it releases the action, so one authorization can release
  one action. Over HTTP you never meet this check: a repeated `businessTransactionId` is refused with `409` before a
  second authorization exists. It protects a system that calls `@parmana/execution-gateway` directly, which refuses a
  replay with `NONCE_ALREADY_CONSUMED`.
- **The approval nonce.** A signed human approval carries a nonce too, and is accepted once. Sending the same approval
  again, even under a new `businessTransactionId`, is refused with `403 POLICY_DENIED`: the approval no longer
  verifies, so the policy's approval signal is false (`declared signal(s) do not match independently verified state
(humanApproved=true != verified humanApproved=false)`). Ask the approver for a new approval. See [Human
  approval](/concepts/human-approval).

Both are stored in Postgres (`consumed_nonces` and `consumed_approval_nonces`), so they hold across every instance
of a deployment, not per process. Only the test suite (`NODE_ENV=test`) keeps them in memory. See [Execution
Authorization](/concepts/execution-authorization) for the full mechanism.

## What this means together

Three replay defenses exist at different layers, and none is an `Idempotency-Key` header:

| Layer                              | Mechanism                           | What repeating gets you                                         |
| ---------------------------------- | ----------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| REST API (`businessTransactionId`) | Unique key in the database          | `409`, not the original response                                |
| Human approval (approval nonce)    | Single use, checked in the database | `403 POLICY_DENIED`, nothing runs                               |
| Internal authorization (`nonce`)   | Single use, consumed by the gateway | Refused by the gateway (`NONCE_ALREADY_CONSUMED`), nothing runs |

None of them is configurable per request, and there is no way to opt out of the `businessTransactionId` uniqueness
check from the API.

---

## Error Catalog

Source: https://docs.parmanasystems.com/api-reference/error-catalog

<Info>
  **[AVAILABLE]**. Rows come from responses captured from the server and from
  the integration tests that assert them, checked against the code on
  2026-10-02. See [Error handling](/api-reference/error-handling) for the
  envelope shape this table assumes.
</Info>

## Authentication

| Status | Code                | Message                                                                                          | Condition                                                                                                                         | What to do                                                                                                      |
| ------ | ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 401    | none                | `authentication required`                                                                        | `Authorization` header missing, not a `Bearer <key>`, or the key doesn't match a configured hash                                  | Send a valid key from [Authentication](/api-reference/authentication). Not retryable without fixing the header. |
| 503    | `AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE` | `Caller authentication audit trail is unavailable; refusing to proceed without an audit record.` | The server could not write the caller audit event a request needs (a database outage). Any authenticated route. Nothing was done. | Retry later with the same request.                                                                              |

## Authorization (caller is known; not permitted for this principal or action)

| Status | Code                     | Message                                                         | Condition                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              | Routes                                | What to do                                                                                                                                                                      |
| ------ | ------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 403    | none                     | `Caller is not permitted to assert this authority.principalId.` | `transaction.authority.principalId` is missing/empty, or doesn't equal the authenticated `callerId` (default, no `allowedPrincipalIds` configured for this key), or isn't present in that key's configured `allowedPrincipalIds` list (`isPrincipalAllowed`, `packages/api/src/routes/execute.ts` / `transactions.ts`) | `POST /execute`, `POST /transactions` | Set `authority.principalId` to an identity this caller's key is actually permitted to assert. Skipped entirely (no 403 possible) when caller authentication itself is disabled. |
| 403    | `CAPABILITY_NOT_ALLOWED` | `Caller is not permitted to invoke this capability.`            | `intent.action` is not in the key's `allowedCapabilities`, or the key has no `allowedCapabilities` (a key with none may invoke nothing)                                                                                                                                                                                | `POST /execute`, `POST /transactions` | Use a key granted that action; `GET /callers/me` lists what yours may invoke. Nothing was evaluated.                                                                            |
| 403    | `TENANT_NOT_ALLOWED`     | `Caller is not permitted to act for this tenantId.`             | `metadata.tenantId` is set and is not in the key's `allowedTenantIds` (a key with none may send no tenant id). The tenant id selects the signing key, so it must come from the key                                                                                                                                     | `POST /execute`                       | Remove `metadata.tenantId`, or ask the operator to add the tenant to the key's `allowedTenantIds`. Nothing was evaluated.                                                       |

## Policy denial (request well-formed; the business rule said no)

| Status | Code            | Message                                        | Condition                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | Routes                                | What to do                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| ------ | --------------- | ---------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 403    | `POLICY_DENIED` | `Execution rejected: <policy-specific reason>` | Policy evaluation returned `REJECTED` (`ExecutionGate.enforce`, `packages/runtime/src/ExecutionGate.ts`). This includes a required human approval that is missing, expired, for other content or already used (the reason then names the approval signal, for example `humanApproved=true != verified humanApproved=false`), a bound signal that does not match the Intent, and a request naming a policy version that is not the one in effect | `POST /execute`, `POST /transactions` | This is a real, observed pipeline outcome, not a bug: the request was well-formed but the business decision was no. Read the reason string; it names the specific Policy condition that failed. Distinct from the caller identity 403 above: that one is about who the caller may act as, this one is about whether the requested action itself is allowed. Previously indistinguishable from a genuine server error (both surfaced as a generic `500`), now corrected. |

## Validation (caller's request is malformed)

| Status | Code                               | Message                                                                                                                                        | Condition                                                                                     | Routes                                                                 | What to do                                                                                                                    |
| ------ | ---------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 400    | none                               | `businessTransactionId must be a valid UUID.`                                                                                                  | `businessTransactionId` present but not a valid UUID v1-v5                                    | `POST /execute`, `POST /transactions`, `POST /verify`, `POST /receipt` | Fix the ID format. Not a transient failure.                                                                                   |
| 400    | none                               | `businessTransactionId is required.`                                                                                                           | `businessTransactionId` missing entirely                                                      | `POST /replay`                                                         | Include the field. `/replay` checks presence only, not UUID format, unlike the routes above.                                  |
| 400    | none                               | `authorization.authorityId must match authority.authorityId.`                                                                                  | A Business Transaction trust-chain invariant failed (`BusinessTransactionValidationError`)    | `POST /execute`, `POST /transactions`                                  | Fix the request body's internal consistency; this is one example invariant among several the shared validator enforces.       |
| 400    | none                               | `{"valid":false,"errors":["policyId is required."]}` / `["policyVersion is required."]`                                                        | `policyId` or `policyVersion` missing/empty, checked in that order, first miss short-circuits | `POST /policies/validate`                                              | Supply both fields. This route never uses the shared `{error}` envelope, see [Error handling](/api-reference/error-handling). |
| 400    | `INVALID_SANDBOX_APPROVAL_REQUEST` | `The sandbox approver signs only for capability "sandbox:receipt".` or `resourceId is required: the request's target, at most 200 characters.` | Sandbox only: another capability, or a missing, empty or long `resourceId`                    | `POST /sandbox/approvals`                                              | Ask for `sandbox:receipt` with the target you will send. Nothing was signed.                                                  |

## Not found

| Status | Code                               | Message                                                                           | Condition                                                                                                                                                   | Routes                                                                          | What to do                                                                                                                            |
| ------ | ---------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 404    | none                               | `Policy '<name>' version '<version>' was not found.`                              | `transaction.policy.name`/`version` doesn't match any published Policy (`PolicyNotFoundError`)                                                              | `POST /execute`, `POST /transactions`                                           | Publish the policy first, or fix the name/version in the request.                                                                     |
| 404    | none                               | `{"valid":false,"errors":["Policy '<name>' version '<version>' was not found."]}` | Same condition as above, different envelope                                                                                                                 | `POST /policies/validate`                                                       | Same fix; this route reshapes the error locally instead of using the shared handler.                                                  |
| 404    | `APPROVAL_ISSUER_CHANGE_NOT_FOUND` | `Approver change '<id>' not found.`                                               | No approver change has this id                                                                                                                              | `POST /approval-issuers/changes/{id}/approve`, `.../reject`                     | Use the `changeId` the proposal returned. See [Manage approvers](/guides/manage-approvers).                                           |
| 404    | none                               | `Business Transaction not found.`                                                 | No Business Transaction exists for the path ID                                                                                                              | `GET /transactions/{id}`                                                        | Confirm the ID; nothing to retry.                                                                                                     |
| 404    | `VERIFICATION_FAILED`              | `Execution Trust Record not found.`                                               | No Execution Trust Record exists for `businessTransactionId` (`VerificationFailedError`, reused across three POST routes)                                   | `POST /verify`, `POST /receipt`, `POST /replay`                                 | Confirm the record exists via `GET /trust-records/{id}` first.                                                                        |
| 404    | none                               | `Execution Trust Record not found.`                                               | Same underlying condition, but reached via a GET, no `code` field on this path                                                                              | `GET /verification/{id}`, `GET /receipt/latest/{id}`, `GET /trust-records/{id}` | Same fix; note the `code` field's presence depends on which route you called, not on the underlying cause.                            |
| 404    | none                               | `Verification not found.`                                                         | Record exists but has no Verification yet                                                                                                                   | `GET /verification/{id}`                                                        | In practice every Execution produces a Verification synchronously, this is an edge case for records that haven't completed that step. |
| 404    | none                               | `Receipt not found.`                                                              | Record exists but has no Receipt yet                                                                                                                        | `GET /receipt/latest/{id}`                                                      | Call `POST /receipt` first, or the record's Execution hasn't reached that stage.                                                      |
| 404    | none                               | `No authenticated caller identity available.`                                     | No caller identity on the request, in practice only reachable when caller authentication is disabled (`PARMANA_AUTH_DISABLED=true`, local development only) | `GET /callers/me`                                                               | Not reachable under normal, authenticated operation. See [Authentication](/api-reference/authentication).                             |

## Policy in effect (`GET /policies/in-effect`)

| Status | Code                         | Message                                                                                                                            | Condition                                                              | What to do                                                                                                                |
| ------ | ---------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 400    | none                         | `capability is required, for example ?capability=paytm:refund.`                                                                    | The `capability` query parameter is missing or blank                   | Add `?capability=<capability>`.                                                                                           |
| 403    | `CAPABILITY_NOT_ALLOWED`     | `Caller is not permitted to invoke this capability.`                                                                               | A non human caller asked about a capability its key may not invoke     | Ask only about capabilities your key may invoke (`GET /callers/me`).                                                      |
| 404    | `CAPABILITY_NOT_BOUND`       | `No policy is bound to capability "<capability>".`                                                                                 | No policy governs this capability on this deployment                   | Check the capability name. Every request for it would be refused.                                                         |
| 409    | `NO_APPROVED_POLICY_VERSION` | `Every request for "<capability>" is refused right now: <reason>.`                                                                 | The bound policy has no approved version yet                           | Every request is refused until a version is approved through [policy governance](/guides/policy-lifecycle-and-approvals). |
| 503    | `POLICY_VERSION_UNAVAILABLE` | `Every request for "<capability>" is refused right now: <reason>.` or `The policy in effect for "<capability>" could not be read.` | The lookup of the version in effect, or the policy file itself, failed | Retry later. Every request for the capability is refused meanwhile.                                                       |

## Governance (policy changes, approvers, external connectors)

These come from the maker checker routes: `/policies/{name}/{version}/pending-changes` and `/policies/pending-changes`,
`/approval-issuers/changes`, and `/external-connectors/changes`. Every one of them, reads included, needs a human
caller; approve and reject also need a fresh step up signature from the checker. See [Policy lifecycle and
approvals](/guides/policy-lifecycle-and-approvals), [Manage approvers](/guides/manage-approvers) and [Connect any
external system](/guides/connect-any-external-system).

| Status | Code                                   | Message                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | Condition                                                                                                                                                                           | Routes                                                         |
| ------ | -------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 400    | none                                   | The field and its rule, for example `reason is required, at most <n> characters.`                                                                                                                                                         | A field of the proposal is missing or invalid. Nothing was stored.                                                                                                                  | Every propose route                                            |
| 400    | `INVALID_EXTERNAL_CONNECTOR`           | The field and its rule, for example `policy must be a policy name matching ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,127}$.`                                                                                                                                   | A registration or revoke proposal is invalid                                                                                                                                        | `POST /external-connectors/changes`                            |
| 400    | `EXTERNAL_ENDPOINT_ADDRESS_REFUSED`    | `The endpoint host '<host>' does not resolve.` or `... resolves to an address that is not public (<addresses>).`                                                                                                                          | The endpoint is not a public HTTPS address. Checked when proposed and again when approved.                                                                                          | `POST /external-connectors/changes`, `.../approve`             |
| 403    | `NON_HUMAN_CALLER_DENIED`              | `This action requires a caller credential provisioned as a verified human (credentialHolderType: USER).`                                                                                                                                  | The key is not provisioned as a human (`credentialHolderType: USER`), such as an agent's key or the sandbox demo key. Recorded as a flagged audit event.                            | Every governance route                                         |
| 403    | `SAME_ACTOR_CANNOT_APPROVE_OWN_CHANGE` | `<kind> '<id>' was proposed by this same caller — the proposer (maker) may not also approve or reject it (checker).`                                                                                                                      | The checker is the maker                                                                                                                                                            | Every approve and reject route                                 |
| 403    | `STEP_UP_AUTHORIZATION_INVALID`        | `The step-up authorization envelope is missing, invalid, expired, replayed, or does not match this request.`                                                                                                                              | The step up signature is missing, not from the checker's registered key, expired, already used, or for another change or action                                                     | Every approve and reject route                                 |
| 404    | `PENDING_POLICY_CHANGE_NOT_FOUND`      | `Pending Policy Change '<id>' not found.`                                                                                                                                                                                                 | No policy change has this id                                                                                                                                                        | `POST /policies/pending-changes/{id}/approve`, `.../reject`    |
| 404    | `EXTERNAL_CONNECTOR_CHANGE_NOT_FOUND`  | `External connector change '<id>' not found.`                                                                                                                                                                                             | No external connector change has this id                                                                                                                                            | `POST /external-connectors/changes/{id}/approve`, `.../reject` |
| 409    | `CONFLICT`                             | For example `A PENDING_APPROVAL change already exists for policy '<name>' version '<version>' ...`, `Approver change '<id>' is already APPROVED.`, `Capability '<capability>' already has an active external connector. Revoke it first.` | The change contradicts the current state: another change is already open for the same thing, the change was already resolved, or the key or registration already exists or does not | Every propose, approve and reject route                        |

`APPROVAL_ISSUER_CHANGE_NOT_FOUND` (404) is in [Not found](#not-found) above.

## Rate limited

| Status | Code           | Message                                 | Condition                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | Routes                                                                                                                                                                              | What to do                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| ------ | -------------- | --------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 429    | `RATE_LIMITED` | `Rate limit exceeded. Try again later.` | Caller (by authenticated identity, not IP) exceeded the configured `/execute` rate limit, or the caller's IP exceeded the separate, more permissive `/health`/`/ready` limit, or the shared per IP limit on the unauthenticated verify routes and `/handbook` | `POST /execute`, `GET /health`, `GET /ready`, `POST /refusal/verify`, `POST /execution-intents/verify`, `POST /audit/verify`, `/handbook/download-leads`, `POST /sandbox/approvals` | Back off; the response carries a `Retry-After` header. Not a transient server issue: no nonce is consumed and nothing is signed for a request rejected here. See [Authentication](/api-reference/authentication#rate-limiting) for the mechanism. |

## Conflict

| Status | Code                        | Message                                                                                   | Condition                                                                                                     | Routes                                | What to do                                                                                                                                        |
| ------ | --------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 409    | none                        | `Business Transaction '<id>' already exists.`                                             | A Business Transaction with this `businessTransactionId` already exists (`DuplicateBusinessTransactionError`) | `POST /execute`, `POST /transactions` | This is not a transient failure to retry. Fetch the existing record instead, see [Idempotency and nonces](/api-reference/idempotency-and-nonces). |
| 409    | `RECEIPT_GENERATION_FAILED` | `Execution Trust Record must be successfully verified before a Receipt can be generated.` | The record exists but its latest Verification isn't `VERIFIED`                                                | `POST /receipt`                       | Call `POST /verify` first and confirm `status: VERIFIED` before requesting a Receipt.                                                             |

<Note>
  **Not listed here on purpose:** `NonceAlreadyConsumedError` (409, code
  `NONCE_ALREADY_CONSUMED`) is a real, tested error `error-handler.ts` maps,
  thrown by `ExecutionGateway.execute()` when every other verification check
  passed and only nonce consumption failed (an isolated replay of an
  already-executed authorization). It is not reachable through any of the routes
  this catalog covers: a resubmitted `businessTransactionId` is always caught
  first by the `DuplicateBusinessTransactionError` 409 above, before a second
  authorization, and so a second nonce, is ever generated. It's a library-level
  guarantee for a receiving system calling `@parmana/execution-gateway`
  directly, not an HTTP-reachable outcome of Parmana's own server.
</Note>

## Signing and evidence (the action could not be recorded)

| Status | Code                            | Message                                                                                                                                                                    | Condition                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| ------ | ------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 503    | `SIGNING_UNAVAILABLE`           | `Evidence signing is unavailable; refusing to release the action ... Nothing was executed.`                                                                                | Before release, the signing readiness probe failed (a missing, disabled or denied key, a KMS or network outage, a key mismatch). Nothing was executed. Retry once signing is healthy, with a new `businessTransactionId`, because the original was already accepted.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| 503    | `EXECUTION_INTENT_UNAVAILABLE`  | `The signed Execution Intent for business transaction '<id>' could not be created and stored; refusing to release the action. Nothing was executed. ...`                   | Before release, the signed [Execution Intent](/concepts/execution-intents) could not be signed and stored (a database or signing failure, or the `execution_intents` table is missing). **Nothing was released.** Retry once healthy, with a new `businessTransactionId`, because the original was already accepted.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| 503    | `CONNECTOR_NOT_REGISTERED`      | `No connector is registered for capability '<action>' on this deployment. Nothing was executed. ...`                                                                       | The action was approved, but no connector is registered for it, usually because the connector's credentials are not configured. The operator must configure it, then retry with a new `businessTransactionId`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| 500    | `EXECUTION_RECORD_INCOMPLETE`   | `The action for business transaction '<id>' was released ... reconcile ... authorizationId: <id>.`                                                                         | The action was released to the connector, then the signed Execution Trust Record could not be produced or persisted. **Do not retry as a new transaction.** A signed [Execution Intent](/concepts/execution-intents) exists for it. Read `GET /execution-intents/<businessTransactionId>`: in state `RELEASED`, an operator can rebuild the record with `POST /execution-intents/<businessTransactionId>/finalize`, which never calls the connector. In state `PREPARED`, finalize refuses with `409`, and the outcome must be reconciled against the connector by hand.                                                                                                                                                                            |
| 409    | `AUTHORIZATION_NO_LONGER_VALID` | `Not released: what the authorization for business transaction '<id>' rests on no longer holds (...). Nothing was executed. ...`                                           | RFC-0023 phase 4. The request was decided, but at release a business fact it rested on was past its `validUntil`, or the agent's authority grant had expired or been revoked. Nothing was sent to the connector, and the body says `executionStatus: NOT_EXECUTED`. Send a new request, which is decided again on current facts and authority. The [Execution Intent](/concepts/execution-intents) is `ERRORED`; close it as `NOT_EXECUTED`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| 502    | `EXECUTION_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN`     | `The action for business transaction '<id>' was released to the execution system, but the call failed, so whether it was performed is unknown. ... authorizationId: <id>.` | The action was released and the call to the connector failed: unreachable, timed out, or an error response. Whether it was performed is unknown, and the [Execution Intent](/concepts/execution-intents) is `ERRORED`. **Do not retry as a new transaction.** Check the target system, then close the intent with `POST /execution-intents/<businessTransactionId>/resolve`, recording `EXECUTED` or `NOT_EXECUTED`. The connector's own error is never in the response; it is in the server log (`execution_outcome_unknown`) and in the intent's `failureReason`. Before 2026-09-25 this was a bare `500 Internal Server Error` (G-63). Since RFC-0023 phase 4 the body also says `executionStatus: EXECUTION_UNKNOWN`: never reported as failed. |

## Execution Intents (operator routes)

These come from the routes under `/execution-intents`, see [Execution Intents](/concepts/execution-intents).

| Status | Code                                   | Message                                                                                                                        | Condition                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | Routes                                                                        |
| ------ | -------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 400    | none                                   | `Request body must be an Execution Intent (intentId, businessTransactionId, authorizationId, intentHash, signature required).` | The body of the verify route is not a structurally plausible intent.                                                                                                                                                                                | `POST /execution-intents/verify`                                              |
| 403    | `NON_HUMAN_CALLER_DENIED`              | `This action requires a caller credential provisioned as a verified human (credentialHolderType: USER).`                       | The list and finalize routes need a credential provisioned as a verified human. Any other credential is refused.                                                                                                                                    | `GET /execution-intents/unfinalized`, `POST /execution-intents/<id>/finalize` |
| 404    | none                                   | `Execution Intent not found.`                                                                                                  | No intent exists for the id, or it belongs to a different caller (ownership scoped).                                                                                                                                                                | `GET /execution-intents/<id>`                                                 |
| 404    | `EXECUTION_INTENT_NOT_FOUND`           | `No Execution Intent exists for business transaction '<id>'. ...`                                                              | Finalize was called for a transaction with no intent. Transactions created before Execution Intents have none.                                                                                                                                      | `POST /execution-intents/<id>/finalize`                                       |
| 409    | `EXECUTION_INTENT_RESULT_NOT_RECORDED` | `The Execution Intent for business transaction '<id>' is in state <state> and has no saved execution result ...`               | The intent exists but no execution result was saved, so the Trust Record cannot be rebuilt. The action may or may not have been released. Establish the outcome at the connector and reconcile by hand. Nothing was called or changed.              | `POST /execution-intents/<id>/finalize`                                       |
| 501    | `EXECUTION_INTENTS_NOT_ENABLED`        | `Execution Intents are not enabled on this deployment.`                                                                        | Finalize was called on a deployment where Execution Intents are off. Only possible in `test` or `development` without `EXECUTION_INTENTS_CHECK=true`.                                                                                               | `POST /execution-intents/<id>/finalize`                                       |
| 400    | `EXECUTION_INTENT_RESOLUTION_INVALID`  | `The resolution is invalid: <reason>`                                                                                          | The body of the resolve route is invalid: `resolution` is not `NOT_EXECUTED` or `EXECUTED`, or `note` is missing, blank or over 2000 characters. Nothing was changed.                                                                               | `POST /execution-intents/<id>/resolve`                                        |
| 409    | `EXECUTION_INTENT_NOT_RESOLVABLE`      | `The Execution Intent for business transaction '<id>' is in state <state> and cannot be resolved by hand. ...`                 | The intent is `RELEASED` (rebuild the record with finalize instead), `FINALIZED` (already complete), or a signed Trust Record already exists for the transaction. Only `PREPARED` and `ERRORED` intents can be closed by hand. Nothing was changed. | `POST /execution-intents/<id>/resolve`                                        |

## Server-side (500)

| Status | Code | Message                 | Condition                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | Routes                                | What to do                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| ------ | ---- | ----------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| 500    | none | `Internal Server Error` | A structurally incomplete but UUID-valid body (for example, `businessTransactionId` present but `metadata` missing) throws an unhandled `TypeError` inside `BusinessTransactionValidator.validate` before any typed error class is constructed | `POST /execute`, `POST /transactions` | Send every required nested object from the [OpenAPI reference](/api-reference/introduction)'s request schema. The generic message hides the real cause; it is visible only in server logs. |

## What's deliberately not here

This catalog lists errors from the routes mounted in `packages/api/src/app.ts`. It does not cover
exceptions raised only in code paths unreachable from the HTTP API (for example, internal
validator classes that never escape a route handler uncaught), or client-side SDK exceptions,
see [Python SDK](/sdks/python) and [TypeScript SDK](/sdks/typescript) for how each wraps these
same HTTP responses.

---

## 9. Errors and troubleshooting

Source: https://docs.parmanasystems.com/build-book/09-errors-and-troubleshooting

Every error body is `{ "error": "<message>", "code": "<CODE>" }`. A few answers carry no `code`; the message then
says what is wrong. Every code, with the operations that return it, is in the
[error reference](/build-book/reference-errors).

## The one rule

**Know whether the action may have run before you retry.** Parmana's answers fall into three groups:

| Group                           | Answers                                                                           | Retry?                                                                                                    |
| ------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Refused, nothing ran            | `400`, `401`, `403`, `404`, `409` (except `NONCE_ALREADY_CONSUMED`), `429`, `503` | Fix the cause, then send a **new** transaction. `429`: wait for `Retry-After`.                            |
| Released, the record is missing | `500 EXECUTION_RECORD_INCOMPLETE`                                                 | **No.** The action ran. The operator finalizes the record ([Chapter 7](/build-book/07-verify-and-audit)). |
| Released, the outcome unknown   | `502 EXECUTION_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN`                                                   | **No.** The action may have run. The operator checks the system and resolves the intent.                  |

The SDKs never retry a `POST` on their own; they retry only `GET` requests, and only when you configure a retry policy.

## How the SDKs raise them

| HTTP                              | TypeScript (`@parmana/sdk`)                     | Python (`parmana.errors`)                        |
| --------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------ |
| 403 with `POLICY_DENIED`          | `ExecutionRejectedError`                        | `ExecutionRejectedError`                         |
| 403 with `CAPABILITY_NOT_ALLOWED` | `AuthorizationError` (`serverCode` set)         | `AuthorizationError`                             |
| 400                               | `ValidationError`                               | `ValidationError`                                |
| 401                               | `AuthenticationError`                           | `AuthenticationError`                            |
| 403, any other                    | `AuthorizationError`                            | `AuthorizationError`                             |
| 404                               | `NotFoundError`                                 | `NotFoundError`                                  |
| 409                               | `ConflictError`                                 | `ConflictError`                                  |
| 429                               | `RateLimitError` (`retryAfterSeconds`)          | `RateLimitError` (`retry_after_seconds`)         |
| 5xx                               | `InternalServerError`, the code in `serverCode` | `InternalServerError`, the code in `server_code` |

Every error from a response carries its status: `statusCode` in TypeScript, `status_code` in Python. Decide on a 5xx by
its code, never by the status alone.

## By status

### 400: the request is malformed

| Code                                                              | Meaning and fix                                                                              |
| ----------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `AUTHORITY_REQUIRED`, `AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED`, `INTENT_REQUIRED` | A section of the Business Transaction is missing. Build it with `createBusinessTransaction`. |
| No code, `approves without a signed human approval`               | The policy named cannot load ([Chapter 4](/build-book/04-policies)).                         |
| `INVALID_EXTERNAL_CONNECTOR`, `EXTERNAL_ENDPOINT_ADDRESS_REFUSED` | A registration was refused ([Chapter 6](/build-book/06-connect-your-systems)).               |
| `EXECUTION_INTENT_RESOLUTION_INVALID`                             | `resolution` must be `NOT_EXECUTED` or `EXECUTED`, with a `note`.                            |

### 401: no valid key

`{"error":"authentication required"}`, with a `WWW-Authenticate` header. The key is missing, wrong, rotated, or not
sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Nothing about the request was read.

### 403: not allowed

| Code                                   | Meaning and fix                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| -------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `POLICY_DENIED`                        | **The policy refused.** A correct answer, with the policy's reason. If the reason asks for an approval, get one signed and send a new transaction ([Chapter 5](/build-book/05-human-approvals)). A Refusal Record was stored. |
| `CAPABILITY_NOT_ALLOWED`               | The key may not use this action. The operator adds it to `allowedCapabilities`.                                                                                                                                               |
| No code, about the principal           | The key may not act for this `principalId`. Act as your own `callerId`.                                                                                                                                                       |
| `NON_HUMAN_CALLER_DENIED`              | A governance call from a key not registered as a human.                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `SAME_ACTOR_CANNOT_APPROVE_OWN_CHANGE` | The checker is the maker. A different person approves.                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `STEP_UP_AUTHORIZATION_INVALID`        | The step up signature expired (120 seconds), was used, is for another change or decision, or does not match the checker's registered key. Sign again and send at once.                                                        |

`POLICY_DENIED` covers every refusal by the decision, each with its own message:

| Message starts with                                                                                                                | Cause and fix                                                                                                           |
| ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| The policy's own reason, for example `Refund rejected. Every refund needs ...`                                                     | A rule refused. If it asks for an approval, get one signed and send a new transaction.                                  |
| `Rejected: capability "x" requires policy "p"@"v", but ... was declared.`                                                          | The request names another policy or an old version. Read `GET /policies/in-effect` and send that.                       |
| `Rejected: declared signal(s) do not match independently verified state (managerApproved=true != verified managerApproved=false).` | The approval is missing, expired, used, by an untrusted key, for another resource, or below the amount. Sign a new one. |
| `Rejected: declared signal(s) do not match the executed intent (refundAmount=900 != intent.parameters.amount=750).`                | A bound signal does not equal its request field. Copy the value from the request.                                       |
| `Rejected: no version of policy "p" ... has been approved through policy governance`                                               | No approved version yet. Approve one ([Chapter 4](/build-book/04-policies)).                                            |

### 404: not found

| Code                                                                                                         | Meaning and fix                                                                                   |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `CAPABILITY_NOT_BOUND`                                                                                       | No policy is bound to the action: not a built in capability, and no active external registration. |
| `POLICY_NOT_FOUND`                                                                                           | The policy named does not exist on the server.                                                    |
| `BUSINESS_TRANSACTION_NOT_FOUND`, `EXECUTION_INTENT_NOT_FOUND`                                               | No record with that `businessTransactionId`.                                                      |
| `PENDING_POLICY_CHANGE_NOT_FOUND`, `APPROVAL_ISSUER_CHANGE_NOT_FOUND`, `EXTERNAL_CONNECTOR_CHANGE_NOT_FOUND` | No change with that id.                                                                           |
| `VERIFICATION_FAILED`                                                                                        | The record for that id could not be verified or found; the message says which.                    |

### 409: conflict

| Code                                   | Meaning and fix                                                                                                                        |
| -------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `DUPLICATE_BUSINESS_TRANSACTION`       | This `businessTransactionId` was already used. To retry the same attempt, read its record; for a new attempt, build a new transaction. |
| `NONCE_ALREADY_CONSUMED`               | This exact authorization was already released: the action ran. Read its record; do not send it again as a new transaction.             |
| `NO_APPROVED_POLICY_VERSION`           | No version of the bound policy is approved. Every request is refused until one is.                                                     |
| `CONFLICT`                             | A change is already open, or already resolved, or a registration is already active.                                                    |
| `EXECUTION_INTENT_NOT_RESOLVABLE`      | The intent is `RELEASED` (finalize it) or already final.                                                                               |
| `EXECUTION_INTENT_RESULT_NOT_RECORDED` | Finalize has nothing to build from: the intent is not `RELEASED`.                                                                      |

### 429: too many requests

`RATE_LIMITED`. Wait for the `Retry-After` header, then retry the same request.

### 500, 502: the action may have run

| Code                          | Meaning                                                                                                         | Do                                                                                                                                                                      |
| ----------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `EXECUTION_RECORD_INCOMPLETE` | The action was released; the signed record was not stored.                                                      | Do not resend. `POST /execution-intents/{id}/finalize` rebuilds the record without acting again.                                                                        |
| `EXECUTION_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN`   | The release failed after it may have reached the system: a timeout, an error, an answer that failed the checks. | **Never resend as a new transaction.** Check the system with the `businessTransactionId` and `target`, then `POST /execution-intents/{id}/resolve` with what you found. |

For an external connector, a request naming a parameter the registration does not allow, or an endpoint whose host
now resolves to a non public address, is also reported as `502 EXECUTION_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN` although nothing was sent.
Check the endpoint's own record before resolving.

### 503: unavailable, nothing ran

| Code                           | Meaning                                                                                  |
| ------------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `CONNECTOR_NOT_REGISTERED`     | No connector for the action: not configured, or the external registration is not active. |
| `SIGNING_UNAVAILABLE`          | The signing path is unhealthy. Nothing is released until it is fixed.                    |
| `EXECUTION_INTENT_UNAVAILABLE` | The intent store is unavailable (or its table is missing after an upgrade).              |
| `POLICY_VERSION_UNAVAILABLE`   | The server could not read the policy in effect.                                          |
| `AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE`            | The audit store is unavailable.                                                          |

Retry later with a **new** transaction. If it persists, tell the operator; each is an alert in
[Chapter 8](/build-book/08-deploy-and-operate).

## Common situations

| You see                                                         | Cause                                                                        | Fix                                                                            |
| --------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `403 POLICY_DENIED`, `requires policy ... but ... was declared` | The agent sent an old policy version.                                        | Read `GET /policies/in-effect` before each request; never hard code a version. |
| Every request refused after a policy change was proposed        | The new version is not approved, or the agent names a version not in effect. | Approve it, then read the version in effect.                                   |
| A server that will not start                                    | A required setting is missing or wrong; the message names the variable.      | [Environment variable reference](/deployment/environment-variables).           |
| `PGRST205` "Could not find the table"                           | The database's schema cache is stale.                                        | `NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema';`                                               |

More, by symptom: [Troubleshooting](/troubleshooting).
